incidenti_noti: APT29 (The Dukes/Nobelium) targeting South Korean security software providers

contesto_generale: In Q3 2022, South Korea experienced significant political developments, including the inauguration of Yoon Suk-yeol as the 13th president on May 10. The People Power Party, led by President Yoon, decisively won the local elections held on June 1. The country also faced natural disasters, such as the 2022 South Korean floods in August, which caused widespread damage. Additionally, a tragic incident occurred in Seoul during Halloween on October 29, where a large crowd of people were crushed in a narrow street, resulting in at least 156 deaths and 172 injuries.
